profile.headline: Software Engineer | United States Marine
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer and a United States Marine with a background shaped by adaptability, discipline, and a drive to continuously improve.

After graduating high school, I attended Towson University unsure of my long-term career path. Following a semester of exploration and extensive research, I chose to pursue Sport Management, drawn to the fast-paced nature of the industry and the opportunity to work with major sports organizations in a dynamic environment.

During my final fall semester, I realized I wasn’t fully confident in my readiness to enter the workforce. Shortly after graduating in May 2019, I made the decision to enlist in the United States Marine Corps and shipped to boot camp in August 2019. After completing intensive basic training, combat training, and Military Occupational Specialty training, I returned home prepared to continue pursuing a career in the sports industry while serving in the Marine Corps Reserves.

Like many industries, sports was heavily impacted by the pandemic, which made it difficult to find meaningful opportunities aligned with my career goals. During this time, a friend introduced me to Hack Reactor’s 13-week immersive software engineering bootcamp. I embraced the challenge, committed to learning JavaScript fundamentals, and earned acceptance into the program.

Within months, I transitioned from learning the basics of programming to building full-stack web applications. More importantly, I discovered a passion for creating technology that others can use and enjoy. Today, I combine the leadership, resilience, and problem-solving skills developed in the Marine Corps with my technical expertise as a Software Engineer.

If you’re interested in my journey or would like to connect, feel free to send me a message here on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Work in an IT development environment focused on engineering analysis and creation of technical solutions for DoD clients.
· Provide technical direction or perform complex analyses individually or in coordination with team members.
· Confer with DoD stakeholders in the design, implementation, and maintenance of web applications and data collection exhibits. Propose web application and data collection exhibit build strategies and create action plans to carry out those strategies.
· Develop new and modify legacy software applications as prompted by changing system requirements.
· Manage System Administration aspects of the team’s IT environment.
· Design and develop web sites and data collection exhibits based on client requirements. 
· Prepare exhibit technical documentation, block diagrams, and/or logic flowcharts.
· Prepare sample test data, conduct program tests, analyze test results, and debug program errors. 
· Ensure operational readiness and security of IT systems. 
· Manage encrypted SQL Server databases across multiple platforms; configure and maintain database servers and processes; monitor system performance; analyze and correct issues in real-time; provide suggestions for solutions.
· Provide server administration to Windows IIS web server and Windows SQL database server.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Software Industry

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a scalable backend

Node.js | Express | MongoDB | Mongoose | dotenv

- Built a production-style ETL pipeline to efficiently ingest, transform, and load 1M+ records into MongoDB.

- Developed RESTful APIs to enable seamless communication between the backend and the React client, optimizing data retrieval for dynamic UI components.

- Implemented query optimization and server-side logic to enhance API performance and support smooth, low-latency user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built an online multiplayer app emulating the classic social deduction game Werewolf. 

React | React Hooks | Node.js | Express | Socket.io | MongoDB | AWS 

Produced an instantly shared game state across multiple users and a live chat using Socket.io to achieve a true multiplayer experience. Received an app proposal from a client, to allow the client to play one of his favorite games "Werewolf" with his friends. Request for this app including online communication via chat or video, ability to change game settings, ability to play multiple rounds and ability to play with additional roles like 'seer' and 'healer'. 

With socket.io we were able to share the game state instantly as well as incorporate 3 live chats, available to users based on their role in the game.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a client facing app providing clothing products for customers

React | React Hooks | Axios | Express | Node.js

This project is a react client powered by an express/nodejs server for hosting static files.
To improve page load time, the client makes use of a javascript API wrapper that fetches and caches data locally using IndexedDB. So that the page is not loading stale data, a service worker pre-fetches fresh data for related products, questions and reviews from the server as the user is browsing the page.

To further optimize performance, we used express/webpack compression libraries to reduce the bundle size from 3-4mb to ~700k which decreased time to first pain from 4s to <1s.

The CSS is driven by styled components and a theme provider that allows simple theme switching and color changing.

Most React components are functional and make use of hooks for basic state management.

positions.title: Spring Student Event Staff
positions.description:
- Gain first hand experience executing high school and college level lacrosse games
- Interact with USL departments like sponsorship and marketing
- Learn how to produce a college level athletic event
- Organize game day staff and other duties on any given game day
- Help with roles such as scoreboard or shot clock operator, field setup, public address announcer, and working with teams and officials

positions.title: Runner
positions.description:
- Interact with the guests and ensure assistance to create a memorable experience of their NinjaBE experience.
- Runners stand for 8 hours a shift at one FitGame station, engaging customers, and honing their own fitness capabilities. They may also help Party Hosts with setup, on-going, and close-out party processes. 
- Demonstrate safe use of NinjaBE obstacles.

positions.title: Sales And Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Researching High School and Pre High School coaches to gain addition information baseball program; success, new program, state rankings, etc.
• Writing nominations to players that have been identified by their high school coach as top players in their program.
• Manage data entry into Sales Force; pull reports and data analytics as needed. Factory Athletics will train on use of Sales Force.
• Providing various administrative support to the PREP team
• Contribute positively to the sales team culture by developing mutually beneficial working relationships with all team members.

positions.title: Athletic Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Game day operations (pre and postgame logistics, including set up of sound system, acting as liaison with media partners, prepare roster print outs for announcer and broadcasters, communicate with team managers to obtain starters, organize and facilitate postgame interviews, to name most)
•	Planning and operation of conference, regional and/or national tournaments, including, but not limited to travel arrangements, communication of scores, and social media content 
•	Input rosters, schedules, photos, statistics and other program information to Presto Sports website 
•	Compose game recap articles when necessary 
•	Compose live social media (Facebook and Twitter) updates during athletic contests 
•	Live game stats via Presto Sports website 
•	Proofread eligibility for student-athletes

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
Flooring Associate :
-	Assist customers with special orders and installed sales 
-	Follow up with customers via telephone when appropriate 
-	When necessary, handle several customers at once
-       Resolve customer complaints or involves the appropriate manager to ensure customer satisfaction
-	Acquired knowledge cutting keys, ropes, blinds, carpet, wood, and mixing paint
-	Educate customers about the whole project
-	Escort customers to appropriate merchandise in all departments 
-	Make decisions on markdowns when necessary to satisfy customer 
-	Execute daily stock maintenance: all products are signed, displayed, lit and clean 
-	Assist with minor resets and cross merchandising as necessary (including wing stacks, chip clips, displays and ads) 
-	Acquire beginner product knowledge in adjacent departments 
-	Cooperate with other Associates when asked to help
-	Act as spotter when necessary
